notes.title: Shields Up'date'
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Kanso
I hope it continues to bring you much joy and relaxation.

In this update:

  Upgraded touch control system
  New health system
  Upgraded controller control system
  Fixed small bugs
  Performance optimisations

In an ongoing effort to balance Kanso as well as possible I have reworked the controls, fixed some quirks and made it all feel more pleasant. 
Also!
Kanso now has shields that you can pick up along an enzô.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39078097/730e8d357d9fd909d33afce663b2ecbf96680484.gif

Only on difficult levels, there are now points of light you can pick up that generate a protective shield.  This allows you to collide with daemons but still complete your circle.  
Be aware, doing so will result in an imperfect completion. This will show up for each level as a black enzô in the level select worlds.
To get a white enzô completion state you but complete the level with NO collisions. 
A perfect circle.


Get Kanso here

The end result being Kanso, something beautiful put into the world.
Thank you.

notes.content:

Hello everyone, I wanted to give you all a small update to the progress of Kanso.
I've been away for the last month or so for personal health reasons, but I'm starting to make the first steps back to work.

In the coming weeks I will be updating Kanso with mostly bug fixes, polishing and some new features.

The road map (minus timings) looks a little something like this:

 Adding a new infinite play mode.
 Adding breathing tool.
 Adding some new music.
 Adding a lot of new quotes.
 Some polishing on the tutorial instructions.
 and a wee bit more...


Hope you are all well and we will see you soon with updates galore!

notes.title: Accessibility Mode
notes.content:
Added in this update is the new accessible way to play Kanso.
Simply press and hold a direction on your D-pad or Arrow keys.  And you will start on the corresponding position on an ensō.
Keep holding the key and you will glide round each of the shapes, press two directions to slow your progress and avoid the Daemons.

Included in this update:

 New Accessibility mode
 New guide pages (accessibly in-game)
 Controller/mouse/touch tweaks
 New controller layout 
 Bug fixes and tweaks

notes.title: Kanso Early Access Release
notes.content:
Now live on Early Access.

Come join me in my journey to complete Kanso and find a relaxing place to let the world melt away.
This is a low stress, minimal challenge, and soothing game. 
Get Kanso now

Zen
Inspired by the Zen calligraphy practice of Ensô, where every day you paint an uninhibited ink circle on a blank sheet of paper.  
Expressing a physical moment of reflection, focus, and freedom of flow.  
As you move around the circular forms, avoiding the Koi like Daemons.   Kanso is carefully balanced to invoke the flow of this calligraphic practice as a unique gameplay experience. 

Features
Over 300 levels (128 currently)
Weekly updates
Unique meditative gameplay
Original soothing music
Cloud Save 
Visual narrative
Designed specifically to manifest relaxation and well being
Get Kanso now
